sources.description: Seed 20261107; 80 four-product markets. Independent uniform [-1,1] quality and cost shifters; independent N(0,0.03^2) demand and cost shocks. Utility 1-1.2p+(0.6+0.7nu)x+xi+epsilon with standard normal nu and standard extreme-value epsilon; marginal cost 1.4+0.3z+omega. Seven-node product quadrature and Bertrand prices generate the observed shares. Merge firms 0 and 1 at fitted marginal costs; retain every product, consumer type, and market population.
